title: Accounting entry created [beta]
description: This event occurs when the platform creates an accounting entry based on the accounting script configuration. This event includes a required `external_account_id` field.

accounting_entry_id.description: Unique ID of the accounting entry

accounting_event_id.description: Event ID of the accounting entry

amount.description: Total amount of the accounting entry

created_at.description: Creation date and time of the accounting entry in ISO 8601 format, including an explicit UTC offset. The offset is a constant -03:00 (America/Recife, which does not observe daylight saving time) and is the same across all environments and datacenters.

credit_account.description: Credit account of the accounting entry

credit_cost_center.description: Credit cost center of the accounting entry

debit_account.description: Debit account of the accounting entry

debit_cost_center.description: Debit cost center of the accounting entry

entry_type_id.description: Entry type of the accounting entry

external_account_id.title: External account ID
external_account_id.description: Custom account ID used to identify the account within your organization. This value links the Pismo account to your internal account identifier. This field is a key that links a Pismo account to your account ID.

program_id.description: Program ID of the accounting entry

transaction_id.description: Transaction ID of the accounting entry

installment_number.description: Sequential number that represents the order of the installment. The ordering starts with 1.
